title: Speculative enquiry: junior civil designer or civil draftsperson (Mulgrave, Melbourne)
content_text: Careers page: 'We are always looking for passionate engineers, designers and draftsmen to join our team. Please submit your CV and a formal cover letter to thiruk@tgvk.com.au.' Office Suite 24, Level 3, 799 Springvale Road Mulgrave VIC 3170, +61 3 9590 0606. Civil services (tgvk.com.au/service_category/civil-engineering-services/): stormwater design, on-site detention and rainwater harvesting, driveways, paving, fencing and retaining walls, subdivision stormwater design (gravity fed and pumped).
apply_instructions: Email CV and a formal cover letter to thiruk@tgvk.com.au (careers page)
